cc:Work.dc:title: Critical Flexible holdout: first-action correctness
cc:Work.dc:description: 160 paired scenarios from 40 base tasks; separate seeds and templates; one LLM run per preset/scenario. A=short/short, B=short/long, C=long/short, D=long/long (critical/distractor). Correctness verifies the call, required arguments and tool effect; max_steps=1, not final task completion. Report aggregates; individual run files unavailable locally. No confidence intervals reported. Sources: docs/experiments/reports/critical-flexible-holdout-2026-11-12.md
